description: Recover stress during rest. By default a short rest recovers 2 stress and a long rest recovers all of it; the world's stressConfig can change both. Stress never drops below the character's minimum.

bonuses.description: Additional recovery from abilities, conditions, or circumstances

restType.description: Type of rest (defaults: short = 2 stress, long = all stress; the world's stressConfig can change them)

name: recover_stress
